note: Home bodyweight move pool. Every move traced to a real Darebee workout (see 'from'), except entries marked 'standard' which are generic calisthenics/stretch names with my own cue text. Cues are written to be SPOKEN, not read.

moves.name: Neck Tilts
moves.cue: Drop the chin slowly toward the chest, then look up. Nothing forced.

moves.name: Neck Side Tilts
moves.cue: Tip one ear toward the shoulder, then the other. Let the shoulder stay down.

moves.name: Shoulder Rolls
moves.cue: Roll the shoulders back and around, big slow circles.

moves.name: Wrist Circles and Flexion
moves.cue: Circle the wrists both ways, then press the palms together and draw the hands down to open the forearms.

moves.name: Arm Circles
moves.cue: Arms out wide, circles small to large. Both directions.

moves.name: Chest Expansions
moves.cue: Open the arms wide and squeeze the shoulder blades together.

moves.name: Spinal Twists
moves.cue: Arms loose, turn from the ribcage. Hips stay planted.

moves.name: Hip Rotations
moves.cue: Hands on hips, circle the pelvis. Wide and unhurried.

moves.name: Side Leg Raises
moves.cue: Lift the leg out to the side. Hold a wall if balance is shaky.

moves.name: Calf Raises
moves.cue: Rise onto the balls of the feet, pause, lower slowly.

moves.name: March Steps
moves.cue: March on the spot, drive the knee up, swing the opposite arm.

moves.name: High Knees
moves.cue: Fast knees, tall posture, stay light on the feet.

moves.name: Step Jacks
moves.cue: One foot steps out as the arms come up. One foot always on the floor.

moves.name: Side Jacks
moves.cue: Step side to side, one arm rising overhead each rep.

moves.name: Jumping Jacks
moves.cue: Land softly, knees a little bent, hands all the way up.

moves.name: Squats
moves.cue: Down until the thighs are at least parallel, weight in the heels.

moves.name: Split Lunges
moves.cue: Alternate legs. Stay upright, both knees bending.

moves.name: Lunge Step-Ups
moves.cue: Start in a lunge, back knee just off the floor. Drive up through the front heel.

moves.name: Push Back Kicks
moves.cue: Kick one leg straight back until it is level with the body. Knee comes in without touching down.

moves.name: Glute Bridges
moves.cue: Push the hips up, squeeze at the top, lower with control.

moves.name: Single Leg Bridges
moves.cue: One leg points at the ceiling, the other foot drives the hips up. Squeeze at the top.

moves.name: Leg Extensions
moves.cue: On all fours, straighten one leg back and up. Keep the hips level.

moves.name: Side Leg Extensions
moves.cue: Lift the bent knee out to the side. The pelvis does not roll.

moves.name: Shoulder Taps
moves.cue: Tap the opposite shoulder without letting the hips rock.

moves.name: Plank Rotations
moves.cue: Turn as one unit and follow the reaching hand with the eyes.

moves.name: Downward Dog Leg Raises
moves.cue: From downward dog, lift one leg straight back and up. Hips stay level and both hands keep pressing the floor.

moves.name: Climber Taps
moves.cue: Bring the knee to the elbow slowly, no bouncing.

moves.name: Plank Walk-Outs
moves.cue: Walk the hands out to a plank and back. Four slow ones beat twenty rushed.

moves.name: Alternating Arm and Leg Raises
moves.cue: Opposite arm and leg reach out long. Balance across the whole trunk.

moves.name: Dead Bugs
moves.cue: Lower back pressed down. Opposite arm and leg extend together.

moves.name: Flutter Kicks
moves.cue: Small fast kicks, legs a little off the floor, lower back planted.

moves.name: Knee-to-Elbows
moves.cue: Drive the knee up to meet the opposite elbow.

moves.name: Seated Leg Raises
moves.cue: Lean back on the hands, lift one straight leg as fast as you can control.

moves.name: Raised Leg Hold
moves.cue: Keep the leg up and still. This is where the tendons work.

moves.name: Push-Ups
moves.cue: Body in one line, chest to the floor, elbows back not flared.

moves.name: Side Bicep Extensions
moves.cue: Arms straight out to the sides, elbow to hand. Keep the arms parallel to the floor.

moves.name: Bicep Extensions
moves.cue: Both arms push forward from the shoulders and pull back. Do not let the elbows droop.

moves.name: Step Bicep Extensions
moves.cue: Keep stepping side to side while the arms push and pull.

moves.name: Superman Stretches
moves.cue: Lift the arms and chest, squeeze between the shoulder blades, gaze down.

moves.name: Reverse Angels
moves.cue: Arms off the floor, sweep them from overhead down to the hips.

moves.name: Prone Reverse Flys
moves.cue: Chest lifted, open the arms out wide, squeeze and lower.

moves.name: W-Extensions
moves.cue: Arms bent into a W, lift the hands and elbows off the floor.

moves.name: Overhead Punches
moves.cue: One fist straight up until the arm is long beside the ear, back to the chin, swap.

moves.name: Straight Punches
moves.cue: One foot forward, hip turns behind every punch. Make each one complete.

moves.name: Cat-Cow
moves.cue: Breathe in as the back dips, out as it rounds.

moves.name: Child's Pose
moves.cue: Hips back to the heels, arms long, forehead down. Breathe into the back.

moves.name: Seated Forward Fold
moves.cue: Legs long, hinge from the hips, let the spine round. No bouncing.

moves.name: Standing Quad Stretch
moves.cue: Pull the heel toward the glute, knees together, hips forward. Both sides.

moves.name: Chest Opener
moves.cue: Hands clasped behind the back, lift the chest, breathe wide.

moves.name: Figure-Four Glute Stretch
moves.cue: Ankle across the opposite knee, pull the legs in. Both sides.

moves.name: Seated Twist
moves.cue: Sit tall, turn from the ribs, hand behind you. Both sides.

moves.name: Neck Stretch
moves.cue: Ear toward the shoulder, let the weight of the head do the work. Both sides.

moves.name: Wrist and Forearm Stretch
moves.cue: Arm out, palm up, gently draw the fingers back. Both sides.

moves.name: Calf Stretch
moves.cue: Back leg straight, heel down, lean into a wall. Both sides.
